text: I walk through these modern, somewhat sterile corridors and rooms, surrounded by glass, screens, and the bold language of innovation. The world here feels composed of ideas and inventions—linear, efficient, and slightly impersonal. The museum-like exhibits on R+D hint at humanity's drive for progress. But in this space, I feel a little like an observer on the threshold of meaning—curious, slightly detached, aware of the paradox that even in a place celebrating creation, one can feel acutely alone.
